_comment: Thematic-cluster manifest for the Phase A generator (tools/generate.py). SSOT is plugins/elian-store/skills/<name>/ + agents/ + skills/_shared/. This maps the 21 skills into composition-respecting plugins. Revise freely — it is config.

elian-artifacts.description: Artifact generation and team orchestration: route to the right workflow, render schema-validated documents, build decision dashboards, spawn teammates, and brainstorm before committing.

elian-tdd.description: Approval-gated TDD development flow: implement features, fix bugs, and make behavior-changing improvements with shared execution strategy.

elian-review.description: Engineering review and verification: findings-first code review, persona-lens review, verify-skill discovery, verify-skill drift repair, a claim-time evidence gate, and the consumer side of receiving review feedback.

elian-design.description: Design and authoring: UI/UX design artifacts, self-contained house-styled documents, and AI-assisted feature framing.

elian-harness.description: Maintainer tooling: reconcile Claude/Codex global harness drift, draft review-friendly PR/MR descriptions, and finish a development branch (merge / PR / keep / discard) with worktree-safe cleanup.

codex._comment: Codex distribution per skill. claude_only = never ships to Codex; prompt_only = stays a hand-authored Codex prompt (not a shared skill); everything else lint-clean ships as a codex/skills/<name> symlink.
